title: CBC-MAC forgery under superposition access

problem.name: CBC-MAC forgery under superposition access
problem.statement_latex: For the fixed-length CBC-MAC construction attacked by Santoli--Schaffner, given coherent access to the tag function, output a fresh message and a valid tag. The block length is $n$ and the underlying block cipher is modeled as an ideal permutation.
problem.statement_text: For the fixed-length CBC-MAC construction attacked by Santoli–Schaffner, given coherent access to the tag function, output a fresh message and a valid tag. The block length is $n$ and the underlying block cipher is modeled as an ideal permutation.

quantum.headline_latex: $\operatorname{poly}(n)$ coherent tag queries by the Simon-based forgery, which finds an XOR relation between message blocks.
quantum.headline_text: $\operatorname{poly}(n)$ coherent tag queries by the Simon-based forgery, which finds an XOR relation between message blocks.

classical.headline_latex: Classical fixed-length CBC-MAC has birthday-scale generic forgery attacks and security bounds, with $O(2^{n/2})$ tag queries for the relevant collision attacks. The bound concerns the specified secure fixed-length construction and message-query model.
